q_001.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER'

q_004.sql: SELECT AVG(payments) AS avg_monthly_payment FROM loan

q_005.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 10000

q_006.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN district r ON r.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND r.A3 = 'Prague'

q_007.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM trans WHERE account_id = 1 AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'

q_008.sql: SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS owner_count FROM disp dp JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND d.A3 = 'south Moravia' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY owner_count DESC

q_009.sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount FROM client c JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC LIMIT 5

q_010.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id AND c.gender = 'M' JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id WHERE l.status = 'C' AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
